controls.label: Shape model
controls.description: ESA/RMOC MTP019 measured nucleus shape, simplified for display. Neutral gray is a model material, not a photograph or an albedo map. The measured north pole is retained; rotational phase is arbitrary. Solar geometry uses the shared 3 September 2026 epoch.

controls.label: OSIRIS mosaic
controls.description: Four OSIRIS orange-filter observations, 5–6 August 2014. Grayscale with approximate illumination correction and bounded brightness matching; photographed shadows and some seams remain. Gray grid marks missing or rejected imagery. Shadows off shows the mosaic uniformly lit; Shadows on adds modeled lighting at the shared 3 September 2026 epoch. This is not an albedo map.
